ruling: RUL-2026-10-12-008: the director's zip of finalized art is the last input. At intake each file is processed/QC'd, committed under art/ghost_ship_skyglass/, and its repository path is entered here; the generator binds it with --image-ref <commit> (sha256 and bytes are computed from the blob at that commit, never typed).

optional._note: Replacement art for existing records. Add entries as item:<itemId>, asset:<assetId> or ai:<aiUserId> with the repository path; an absent entry keeps the live image untouched.
